description: This file declares functions, classes, enums, and structures related to verifying certificate chains, including the main VerifyCertificateChain() function, delegate interface, and related enums and data structures used in certificate validation within the Chromium project.

classes.name: VerifyCertificateChainDelegate
classes.description: Interface for delegate methods used during certificate chain verification, including checks for signature algorithms, public key acceptability, and obtaining a signature verification cache.

methods.name: VerifyCertificateChain
methods.description: Verifies an ordered chain of DER-encoded certificates according to RFC 5280, with deviations, and checks trust anchor constraints.

methods.name: VerifyCertificateIsSelfSigned
methods.description: Checks if a given certificate is self-signed, optionally using a cache, and provides error details.
